cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That lost entry fee bought us a map of the regional competition. I'll use it to plan the next campaign; put our notes here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We entered to win, not take notes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may call it a loss on today's sheet. On my plan it's paid reconnaissance for the regional trophy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't afford another entry. The village qualifier is free, but we'd have to start again there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then that's our route. I'll build the practice around what beat us today, and you enter us at the village round. We paid to see the standard; next time we arrive knowing how to reach it.
